Hasnain pay yateemi taqdeer lay ke aayi

1
Mola Ali ka ghaam main maghmoon khudayi

2
1) Talwaar-o-zehar dono baba kai sar pay baham
Baiton nai yeh virasat aik aik ker kay payee

3
2) Woh chal basa yateemon baivaon ka sahara
Karta tha jo hamesha dushman say bhalayee

4
3) Kaisa sitam huwa hay baad-e-Ali Khudaya
Ummat hai baitiyon ko bazaar-e-shaam layee

5
4) Hy kaamp utha tha Kufa Zainab ki aah buka sai
Jinno bashar malaaik day tay hain sab duhaee

6
5) Aghaaz ho gaiya hai Karbal ka ya khudaya
Sajday main jab shaki nay talwaar hay chalayee

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/hasnain-pe-yateemi-taqdeer-leke-aayi.md')
_, yaml, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = yaml.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
rb = [b.splitlines() for b in '\\n'.join(l.strip() for l in roman.splitlines()).strip().split('\\n\\n')]
ub = [b.splitlines() for b in body.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert [len(b) for b in rb] == [len(b) for b in ub] == [1,2,3,3,3,3,3]
for i, (r,u) in enumerate(zip(rb[1:],ub[1:]),1):
    assert r[0] == str(i) and u[0] == chr(0x6F0+i)
assert 'direction: \"rtl\"' in yaml and 'noUrdu' not in yaml
print('Verified aligned preamble and six numbered stanzas (12 verses).')
PY

Reconstructed all 12 Urdu verses and verified that they align with the Roman transcription across the preamble and six stanzas. Moved the Roman wording into `romanLyrics`, removed the duplicate inline stanza labels, set the direction to RTL, and cleared the `noUrdu` tag.
